checks.check: magnetic flux weight is exp(-(pi/(2 alpha)) m.m)
exp(-2/alpha) would need m.m = 4/pi, which no integral lattice has
electric dual weight is exp(-2 pi alpha n.n); exp(-2 alpha) would need n.n = 1/pi
for any Gaussian flux sum the product of dual exponents is pi^2 (m.m)(n.n); TFPT has (2a)(2/a) = 4
charge rescaling e -> k e cannot repair it: needs k^2 rational multiple of 1/pi
formal inversion alpha -> 1/alpha does exchange the two exponentials (naming level only)
origin of the '2' in the sources is cover degree times spectral flow (d*SF = 2), a count, not a flux norm
